visual_appeal: The window is now denser than the baseline (image 1). The hero portrait went from about 132 px to about 96 px, and the hero lost its presence. Raise it to 112 px and the name to 30 px.

Scenes 01 and 03: the hero's 1.5 LEVELS BANKED sits too close to the window edge, and the large empty space under it reads as unused. Add a second line under it, such as 'Le Bankken next · 19h', in 11 px #A89A80, so the right column earns its space.

Roster race badges in scene 01 all look like the same grey head on a grey disc. Tint each disc fill to the faction, Alliance #1E2A44 or Horde #3A1414, and keep the bronze rim #8A6A3A. The six rows will then stop looking cloned.
play_next_clarity: The action band text is uniform cream, so the two names do not pop. Colour both names in their class colours, keep 'First:' and 'Then:' in bold gold #E8C46A, and keep the connective words in cream #E6DCC8.
Add a step marker so the order reads at a glance. Use small numbered discs, '1' before the hearth clause and '2' before the play clause, at 14 px on #2A2116 with a gold edge.

NOW PLAYING floats 'No rested XP: kills give normal XP' in the middle, with nothing above or below it. Left-align it to the bar column (x of the roster bars) and put a 2 px red rule (#C83A2E at 60% alpha) above it, so it reads as 'this is why you should switch'.
state_colours: The legend's 'not resting' text is a desaturated pink, while the chip is a true red. Use the same #E0463A for the dot, the text and the chip word.
The RESTING chip border (#C9772E) and the NEARLY FULL border (#E8D040) are fine. The roster's left state rail is only about 4 px, so make it 5 px and match its hex exactly to the chip edge.
Jacques Hammer's row has a red tint, but the bar's red (#C0392B-ish) is darker than the chip's red. Unify the bar fill on #D9443A so the red state is one hue.
character_identity: Badges at 17-24 px are still unreadable in the roster. Every row shows a grey bust. Raise roster badges to 20 px minimum and use the actual race/gender icon atlas in colour (not a desaturated version). If it is already coloured, add +15% brightness.
In NOW PLAYING and the timeline, the badge overlaps the class icon by about 40%, which makes a muddy double blob. Offset it to the bottom-right with a 2 px gap from the portrait circle.

Alert 'Next:' lines (scene 05) stack the class icon and the badge into a cluster about 22 px wide. Show a single 22 px class icon there and drop the race badge. Identity is already carried by the name.
default_theme: The red close button with a plain 'X' (scene 02) looks placeholder next to the bronze Compact button. Use a bronze 22x22 button with an embossed cross (#D8B878) and a 1 px #3A2A14 edge.
The hero's tavern background art is nice, but it fights the speech bubble. Darken it to 55% under the text column with a left-to-right gradient (#000 at 0.6 to 0).
Footer buttons Unlink and All accounts use two different bronze tones. Use one button style for both.
elvui_wc3_fit: Move mode, logout placeholder (scene 04): the wood texture stops about 160 px short of the right edge, leaving a dark slab. The texture is not being stretched or tiled to the new width. Re-apply the backdrop after resizing (SetTemplate after SetSize) so it fills the box.

The Move notifications panel mixes a gold 'Done' with a blue ElvUI 'Reset all'. Under ElvUI, skin both through S:HandleButton so they share the blue, and mark Done as primary with a 1 px gold edge only.

Options outer frame (scene 07) is a flat #3B342C slab with an empty grey search bar. That is nowhere near image 3, which has a near-black panel, tabs on dark and a gold Close. If the Settings frame is ElvUI-owned, leave it. Otherwise, make sure our category canvas does not paint the outer area. Also note the Close button shows a blue sliver artefact top right.

Compact tooltip header (scene 08) has a brown block behind 'Rested Leveling / best to play first'. Even if it is WC3 art, inset the header text 8 px and add a 1 px #6A5534 divider so the block reads as intentional.
alerts_ux: Banner body lines 2 and 3 are the same size and colour as each other. Make line 2 ('Le Jette is outside a rest area.') 12 px #A89A80 and line 3, the instruction, 13 px cream, so the instruction wins.

The Esc card's title 'Find an inn before you log out' and the banner's 'Cancel logout, then rest in an inn' are too similar to tell apart in a glance at scene 05. Give the Esc card a different glyph, such as a moon/inn icon, instead of the same warning triangle.
Toast: the top line 'Le Jette: rested XP used up' is grey at about 11 px and gets lost. It is the trigger, so set it 12 px #E0A040. Keep 'Play Le Dette' as the 14 px headline.
Move mode: the toast placeholder overlaps the right chat panel's top edge by a few px. Default it 8 px higher.
readability: Roster meta lines ('Lv 6 · Thunderbrew inn · 2d ago') are about 11 px #C8BCA6 on #251D14. Raise them to 12 px. The real client will be wider, so check truncation at 'Thunderbrew Distillery'.
Timeline night bands are still slate blue (about #34405A) and dominate the chart. Drop them to #1E2330 at 70% and add a 1 px #3A4560 edge.

Card (scene 06): the summary wraps to 'banked.' alone on line 2, with half the width empty. Restructure it as two lines: 'Resting at Thunder Bluff · 0.1 level banked' / 'Full in 9d · Thu 3 Dec, 05:00'.
Options helper text after Move notifications runs to the panel's right edge, with about 4 px margin. Wrap it at the panel width minus 24 px, or put it under the button.
layout_polish: Card (scene 06): the rest bar sits outside the stage box as a 40 px orange stub on a full-width track, detached from the name and chip. Move it into the stage box under the meta line, full width minus 24 px padding, 10 px tall.
Card: HEARTH and LOGGED OUT IN both say Thunder Bluff. When they match, merge them into 'HEARTH · LOGGED OUT' and use the freed cell for 'Rested rate: 5%/8h in inn'.

Options: vertical rhythm is uneven. There is no gap above APPEARANCE, 14 px above NOTIFICATIONS and a large dead block at the bottom. Use 18 px before every heading and 6 px after, and let the panel distribute the slack.

Footer (scene 01): Unlink, Paired text, All accounts and the checkbox spread across the row unevenly. Group Unlink and the status on the left with 8 px gaps, and the account button and checkbox on the right with 12 px gaps.
NOW PLAYING: 'Not banking: log out in an inn' repeats the NOT RESTING chip. Keep one. Prefer the chip, and replace the sub-line with the location: 'Outside · Feralas'.
delight: The hero speech bubble is the only personality in the main window. Let roster rows show a 1-word mood on hover (zzz for resting, an exclamation for not resting) as a small 12 px glyph.
When #1 is full and wasting rest, add a slow 2 s pulse (alpha 0.6 to 1) on the green rail. Respect Reduce motion.
Timeline: the 'Full now' green dot for Le Dette is the best moment on the chart. Add a small sparkle or a gold ring around it and the label 'Go!'.
Compact tooltip: use the same copy as the main window ('Full since 1d 16h ago' rather than 'Full for 1d 16h') so the voice stays consistent.

overall_notes: This is a real improvement over the baseline and over round 1. The chip family is unified, the timeline gutter works, the banner copy is clear, and the options page is finally structured. What holds it below 9 is finish, not concept. The ElvUI skin is visibly mis-applied in places: the wood does not fill the resized logout placeholder, button colours are mixed in move mode, the outer options frame is flat, and the Close button has an artefact. The race badges are still illegible, and in the roster they look like identical grey heads. The character card's bar and summary are laid out as an afterthought. The hero is now smaller and less heroic than the baseline, and the two action names are not class-coloured despite the brief saying they should stand out. Fix the fill and resize skin bug, the badge legibility and the card layout, and this is a credible 8.5-9.
